text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of an overdose, consider contacting Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) or a medical toxicologist for latest recommendations. Initiate appropriate supportive treatment according to the patient's clinical signs and symptoms. A period of observation and treatment for these symptoms may be necessary, considering the half-life of orforglipron [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] .
